meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体框架装好命令行网关,并恢复运行、审批与设置配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在给智能体框架接入新的网关组件,需要一次装好并恢复运行配置。
copy.tagline_en: Install a CLI gateway into your agent framework and restore runtime and approval setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're wiring a new gateway into your agent framework and need it installed and running.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 OneCLI 作为 NanoClaw 的网关提供方安装或刷新:复制适配器、测试与 agent 指引到常规路径,注册该提供方,安装固定版本 SDK,再运行配置脚本、构建与测试。凭据不会进入 agent 容器。
howto.when: 当 setup 选择 OneCLI、已有 OneCLI 安装要迁移到 gateway seam,或需要从 in-tree 包恢复其运行、审批桥接与指引时触发。

say.text: 把 OneCLI 装成 NanoClaw 的网关提供方
say.note: 会复制文件、注册提供方并运行配置脚本

say.text: 刷新现有 OneCLI 安装并跑构建和测试
say.note: 跑构建与相关 vitest 测试

say.text: 用 NANOCLAW_ONECLI_API_HOST 和 token 连远程网关
say.note: 默认本地网关缺失时使用

howto.what_en: Installs or refreshes OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider: copies the adapter, tests, and agent guidance into place, registers the provider, installs the pinned SDK, then runs the setup script, build, and tests. Credentials never enter an agent container.
howto.when_en: Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, and guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

say_en.text: Install OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider
say_en.note: Copies files, registers provider, runs setup

say_en.text: Refresh the existing OneCLI install and run build and tests
say_en.note: Runs build plus the vitest suites

say_en.text: Connect a remote gateway via NANOCLAW_ONECLI_API_HOST and token
say_en.note: Used when no local gateway is present
